blocks.text: Building management sent the revised parking assignments this morning, and two of our spaces are affected. The reserved row on level two will be closed for resurfacing over the next two weekends. On the building's list, the spaces recorded to Nancy Suarez and Julie Hill move to the visitor bays by the north entrance for that period.

Temporary dashboard placards are required, and the front desk will have them from Thursday. Please collect yours before the weekend, and tell me if the north bays do not suit you so I can ask for a different assignment.
